item.description: by Dustin Bleizeffer, WyoFile After axing a federal doctrine to regulate greenhouse gas emissions earlier this month, the Trump administration rolled back additional air quality standards Friday — this time for limiting mercury and other deadly toxins from coal smokestack emissions.
